raw_output:
Giver: Right, okay. Where are you?
Follower: Oh, I'm here. Where do I start?
Giver: Start at the bottom, right in the middle. Just below the Missionary Camp.
Follower: Okay, got it. I see the camp and the Start mark. Where do I go first?
Giver: Go left. Just a little bit left.
Follower: Left... okay. I'm moving left.
Giver: Good. Now go down, but not too far. Just enough to pass *above* the Gorillas on your right.
Follower: Ah, the Gorillas? Okay, I see them. I'm going down, keeping them on my right side.
Giver: Right. Now swing left again. You're going to pass a Banana Tree. It's not on my map, but it should be there.
Follower: Wait, Banana Tree? I don't see one. I only see... a Rockfall.
Giver: Oh, right, that's a Rockfall on yours. Ignore that. Just keep going left until you hit the edge.
Follower: Okay, left. I hit the edge. Now go up.
Giver: Up a bit. Then turn left again. Watch out, don't go too far, or you'll hit the Gorillas.
Follower: Okay... up and left. I'm feeling a bit lost. Are we going back to the Gorillas?
Giver: No, no! You passed them already. Now you're near the Rope Bridge. It's on the left.
Follower: Okay, I see the Rope Bridge. It's definitely on the left.
Giver: Good. Now go up and right. You'll end up near some Fallen Pillars. Those are on the right.
Follower: Okay, up and right. There are pillars there. Okay, I see them.
Giver: Good. Now go left. You're heading towards the Ancient Ruins. They are on the right side of the path.
Follower: Okay, going left. I see the Ruins on the right.
Giver: Right. Keep going left. You'll pass the Stones. They are on the left.
Follower: Okay, left. I see the Stones.
Giver: Good. Now go up. You should see the White Mountain on the right.
Follower: White Mountain! Okay, I see it. It's on the right.
Giver: Yes. Now go left. Towards the Soft Furnishings Store. That's on the left.
Follower: Soft Furnishings Store. Okay, I see it.
Giver: Right. Go up now. You're almost there. You should see the Gazelles on the left.
Follower: Gazelles! Okay, I see them.
Giver: Good. Finally, go right. You're going to the Finish.
Follower: Right... but wait. I'm going right and I see... a Straight River? And the Waterfall is on the right, but it looks like it's far away.
Giver: Oh, the Waterfall? Yeah, that's on the right. But the Finish is actually further up. Make sure you don't go too far right.
Follower: Okay, not too far right. I see the Finish mark!
Giver: Perfect. You're there.
Follower: Done!
Giver: Great.
Follower: Thanks.
Giver: Bye.
